cookies.description:
Optional. Leave empty to scrape public profiles without signing in. Paste your own Instagram cookies in JSON format to also scrape private profiles your account follows and age-restricted posts. It is a secret input, so the Apify Console hides and encrypts it.

Format: [{"name":"sessionid","value":"...","domain":".instagram.com"}, ...]
cookies.title: Instagram Cookies (Optional)

maxPosts.description: Maximum number of posts to extract per profile (after the date and pinned-post filters below). Set to 0 to only extract profile data without posts. Public profiles need no sign-in, however many posts you ask for.
maxPosts.title: Maximum Posts to Scrape

newerThan.description: Skip posts published before this date. Leave empty for no date filter. Must be a date from 2000-01-01 up to the day before the run. The date is read from the post's id, so it can be off by up to a day.
newerThan.title: Only posts newer than

skipPinnedPosts.description: Leave out the posts a profile has pinned to the top of its grid. A pinned post that is also the newest post cannot be recognised and stays in.
skipPinnedPosts.title: Skip pinned posts

usernames.description: Instagram profiles to scrape. Each entry can be a username (with or without @) or a profile link such as https://www.instagram.com/natgeo/. Each profile is scraped in turn. Example: 'instagram', '@instagram' or 'https://www.instagram.com/instagram/'.
usernames.title: Instagram Usernames
